title.en: Advice from someone who's been there

es: Escribir consejos de viaje usando gerundios e infinitivos perfectos y pasivos con precisión.

teaching.en: Having been to Cusco twice, I can tell you the sunset from the old hill is worth seeing.
teaching.es: Habiendo estado en Cusco dos veces, puedo decirte que vale la pena ver la puesta de sol desde la colina vieja.
teaching.explanationEs: Having + participio al inicio: da autoridad a tu consejo.
segments: Having been to Cusco twice, I can tell you
the sunset from the old hill is worth seeing.
teaching.audioText: Having been to Cusco twice, I can tell you the sunset from the old hill is worth seeing.

teaching.en: I remember being sold a cheap souvenir that was not local, so ask where it was made.
teaching.es: Recuerdo que me vendieron un recuerdo barato que no era local, así que pregunta dónde se fabricó.
teaching.explanationEs: Remember + being + participio: lo que me hicieron y por qué aconsejo.
segments: I remember being sold a cheap souvenir that was
not local, so ask where it was made.
teaching.audioText: I remember being sold a cheap souvenir that was not local, so ask where it was made.

teaching.en: Having found a bargain in the market, I felt proud of my choice.
teaching.es: Después de encontrar una ganga en el mercado, me sentí orgullosa de mi elección.
teaching.explanationEs: Having + participio: la acción previa que explica el sentimiento.
segments: Having found a bargain in the market,
I felt proud of my choice.
teaching.audioText: Having found a bargain in the market, I felt proud of my choice.

teaching.en: Go early to the viewpoint: I was happy to have been warned about the big crowd.
teaching.es: Ve temprano al mirador: me alegré de que me avisaran de la gran multitud.
teaching.explanationEs: Happy to have been + participio: agradecer algo que te hicieron antes.
segments: Go early to the viewpoint: I was happy
to have been warned about the big crowd.
teaching.audioText: Go early to the viewpoint: I was happy to have been warned about the big crowd.

teaching.en: I warn you: avoid being sold tickets by people in the street.
teaching.es: Te aviso: evita que te vendan entradas en la calle.
teaching.explanationEs: Avoid + being + participio: consejo para no recibir una acción.
segments: I warn you: avoid being sold
tickets by people in the street.
teaching.audioText: I warn you: avoid being sold tickets by people in the street.

prompt.es: Completa: «Habiendo vivido años en Quito, ella conoce los mejores miradores.»

feedback.es: Having + participio al inicio explica la experiencia previa que da autoridad.

hint.es: Abre la frase con la forma perfecta en -ing.

origin.text: ___ lived in Quito for years, she knows the best viewpoints.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Evita quedarte sin habitación en julio.»

answer.text: Avoid being left without a room in July
accepted: Avoid being left without a room in July
In July avoid being left without a room

feedback.es: Avoid + being + participio: evitar que otros te dejen sin algo.

hint.es: Empieza con el verbo de consejo; después viene being + participio.

prompt.es: Quieres contar que te vendieron algo muy caro. ¿Qué frase es correcta?

choices.text: I remember to be sold a very expensive map.
I remember having sold a very expensive map.
I remember being sold a very expensive map.

feedback.es: Tú recibes la acción de vender, así que se usa being + participio. Having sold diría que tú lo vendiste.

hint.es: Tú recibes la acción: usa la forma pasiva en -ing.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me alegro de que me avisaran de la larga cola.»

feedback.es: Con glad se usa to have + participio para algo que ocurrió antes.

origin.text: I'm glad ___ have been warned about the long queue.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dice la persona del mercado.

choices.text: The speaker knows the market well but paid too much once.
The speaker has never been to the market.
The speaker got a bargain at the market.

feedback.es: «Having visited three times» indica experiencia, y «charged too much» que pagó de más por un recuerdo.

origin.audio: Having visited the market three times, I can say it is worth going on Saturday, but I was charged too much for a souvenir.

prompt.es: Escribe un consejo con avoid + being: evita que te cobren de más en el taxi.

answer.text: Avoid being charged extra in a taxi.
accepted: Avoid being charged extra in a taxi.
Avoid being charged too much in a taxi.
Avoid being charged extra in the taxi.
Avoid being charged extra by taxi drivers.

feedback.es: Avoid va seguido de being + participio cuando otros te hacen la acción.

origin.text: Consejo: evita que te cobren (charge) de más en el taxi (taxi).

prompt.es: Según el texto, ¿por qué evita la autora la primera tienda?

choices.text: She was charged double at the gate.
She was offered a cheap copy as a bargain.
The first shop is always closed.

feedback.es: Dice que le ofrecieron una ganga que era una copia barata, por eso evita comprar en esa tienda.

origin.text: Great destination, but the market in Cusco is crowded on Saturdays. Having shopped there twice, I recommend going at eight. I remember being offered a bargain that was a cheap copy, so I avoid buying souvenirs in the first shop.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ayudó a los viajeros.

choices.text: They were not warned about the crowd.
The viewpoint was closed at six.
The warning helped them arrive early.

feedback.es: Los avisaron de la multitud y por eso llegaron a las seis y tuvieron el mirador casi para ellos.

origin.audio: The viewpoint was great, and I'm glad to have been warned about the crowd, because we arrived at six and had the place almost alone.

prompt.es: Completa: «Recuerdo que me dijeron que guardara el pasaporte en el hotel.»

feedback.es: Remember + being + participio expresa que alguien te dijo algo.

origin.text: I remember ___ told to keep my passport at the hotel.

prompt.es: Escribe consejos sobre un destino: dos formas perfectas y dos pasivas.

answer.text: Having been to Cusco twice, I can give you some advice. I remember being sold a cheap souvenir that was not local, so ask where things are made. Avoid being charged too much by asking the price first. It is worth going to the viewpoint at seven: I was glad to have been warned about the crowd, and we had the place almost alone. I recommend buying your tickets early, because the market is bound to be full on Saturdays. Finally, take a warm jacket, because the nights are cold.
accepted: Having been to Cusco twice, I can give you some advice. I remember being sold a cheap souvenir that was not local, so ask where things are made. Avoid being charged too much by asking the price first. It is worth going to the viewpoint at seven: I was glad to have been warned about the crowd, and we had the place almost alone. I recommend buying your tickets early, because the market is bound to be full on Saturdays. Finally, take a warm jacket, because the nights are cold.

Having lived in Quito for five years, I know it well. I remember being told the old town was safe at night, but I recommend taking a taxi. Avoid being sold tickets in the street. I'm glad to have been told about the best viewpoint, and it is worth going before the crowd arrives.

Having visited Cusco three times, I can give you some tips. I remember being charged double for a souvenir, so always ask the price. Avoid being stopped by people selling tickets. I was happy to have been warned about the crowd, so I went early. It is worth going to the viewpoint at sunset.

feedback.es: Un buen texto abre con having + participio, cuenta algo con being o been + participio, da consejos con avoid, recommend o worth y cierra con un balance como glad to have been.

origin.text: Elige un destino que conozcas (Cusco, Quito…). Usa dos formas perfectas y dos pasivas (being / been + participio). Escribe entre 70 y 100 palabras.

prompt.es: ¿Qué hace Leo ahora y por qué?

choices.text: He asks where souvenirs are made, because he was sold a cheap one.
He buys fewer souvenirs, because he was charged double.
He never travels, because he lost money.

feedback.es: Leo cuenta que le vendieron un recuerdo barato y que ahora pregunta dónde se fabrica.

origin.text: Leo's note: «I was sold a cheap souvenir. Having learned my lesson, I now ask where it was made.»

prompt.es: Escribe con having + participio: tras visitar Cusco dos veces, recomiendas ir temprano.

answer.text: Having visited Cusco twice, I recommend going early.
accepted: Having visited Cusco twice, I recommend going early.
Having been to Cusco twice, I recommend going early.
Having visited Cusco twice, I recommend that you go early.

feedback.es: La frase abre con having + participio y el consejo lleva recommend + -ing.

origin.text: Habiendo visitado (visit) Cusco dos veces, recomiendas ir temprano (early).

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué mes prefiere la persona.

choices.text: The speaker prefers July to May.
The speaker prefers May to July.
The speaker has never been there.

feedback.es: Dice que vale la pena ir en mayo y que julio estaba demasiado lleno.

origin.audio: It is worth visiting in May. Having been there in July, I can say it is too crowded, and I recommend avoiding being there on weekends.
